milestones.title: Decide and specify
acceptance_criteria: The external consumer question is answered and the new schema is specified and tested

milestones.title: Implement
acceptance_criteria: API, web client and documentation agree on the new list response

tasks.title: Find out who consumes the list endpoint outside this repository
tasks.objective: Decide, with evidence, whether anything outside this repository reads GET /v1/projects and what it needs
tasks.estimate_rationale: The MCP repository is not in this workspace and the drift script only proves it holds a copy of the import schema

complexity.justification: The outcome depends on a repository this workspace does not contain, so the reasoning is about what cannot be seen

scope.justification: A decision note only, no code changes

evidence: assumption:the owner can provide the trainingApp-mcp checkout the same day
duration.justification: Reading a script and one question to the owner; the answer time is not under the plan's control

risk.justification: Read-only, but a wrong answer makes T3 break an unseen consumer

coupling.justification: Its decision shapes T2 and T3 and touches no files they edit

evidence: assumption:the MCP client lists projects through this endpoint
confidence.justification: No evidence of the consumer besides a path in a drift script, so the estimate is preliminary

acceptance_criteria: A written decision states whether a backward-compatible view is required
The decision lists what was checked and what could not be checked

verification.value: read scripts/check-contract-drift.mjs and ask the owner for the trainingApp-mcp repository
verification.expected: a decision note exists that names each consumer and whether it reads the list endpoint

tasks.title: Define the list response schema in contracts
tasks.objective: Add a zod schema for list items and the paginated response with tests, as the single definition both sides import
tasks.estimate_rationale: Schemas follow the style of project.ts; the open point is whether a legacy view must be representable

complexity.justification: Schema design with strict objects like the existing ones plus a decision about a legacy shape

duration.justification: Schemas are about twenty lines; tests follow project.test.ts

risk.justification: Both API and web will import this definition, so a mistake propagates

coupling.justification: API, web and docs all depend on this schema and T3/T4 are ordered after it

confidence.justification: The schema style is clear but T1 may change what must be representable

acceptance_criteria: ProjectListItemSchema and ProjectListResponseSchema are exported from the contracts package
Tests accept a valid page and reject extra or missing fields

tasks.title: Paginate and slim the list endpoint
tasks.objective: Return list items with a cursor from GET /v1/projects and cover it with API tests
tasks.estimate_rationale: Public response shape change in app.ts and repository.ts, with unknown external consumers; needs ordering rules and tests from scratch

complexity.justification: Cursor semantics over updated_at ordering with ties, plus a compatibility decision from T1

scope.justification: Route, repository method and new tests across the API, visible to every client

duration.justification: Larger than a plain endpoint: ordering ties, tests and the compatibility branch

risk.justification: A public response shape consumed outside this repository: breaking it fails clients we cannot test

coupling.justification: Web client and docs consume exactly this response, and the contracts schema defines it

evidence: assumption:updated_at alone is enough as a cursor
confidence.justification: The code is read, but the external consumer behaviour and tie ordering are not verified

acceptance_criteria: GET /v1/projects returns projects as list items and a nextCursor
A second request with nextCursor returns the following page without duplicates
Behaviour for external consumers follows the T1 decision

verification.purpose: new list tests and the existing suite pass

tasks.title: Consume nextCursor in the web client and its two screens
tasks.objective: Make listProjects, the project list and the tabs bar read list items and follow nextCursor
tasks.estimate_rationale: Three files; both screens call listProjects and render all projects at once today

complexity.justification: Paging in two client components that currently fetch once

scope.justification: Three files in the web workspace

duration.justification: Two components with their own refresh logic and a manual check

risk.justification: A paging bug hides projects from the user without an error

coupling.justification: It consumes the response T3 produces and shares listProjects between two components

confidence.justification: Call sites were found with grep, but the web workspace has no automated UI tests

acceptance_criteria: listProjects returns items and the next cursor
Both screens still show every project, loading further pages when needed

verification.purpose: web compiles against the new response

verification.value: open /projects in the web app with more than one page of projects
verification.purpose: see the list and the tabs bar
verification.expected: all projects appear and none is duplicated

tasks.title: Document the new list contract
tasks.objective: Describe the paginated list response in the API contract document
tasks.estimate_rationale: One existing document gains a short section

complexity.justification: Documentation of behaviour fixed in T3

scope.justification: A single section in one document

duration.justification: Short section matching the existing document style

risk.justification: Documentation only, reviewed in the diff

coupling.justification: Reads the final behaviour of T3 and is ordered after it

confidence.justification: The document exists and its format is known

acceptance_criteria: docs/api-contract.md describes projects, nextCursor and the compatibility decision from T1

verification.expected: the document describes the paginated response and the compatibility note
